app.name: PumpkinOS
app.long_description:
PumpkinOS runs PalmOS applications: Memo Pad, Address Book, To Do List, Date Book, a web browser, a mail client, GNUBoy and more.
Point the Wiimote at the screen to move the pointer, A is the pen, B is Escape, + is Enter, - is Backspace, Home goes back to the Launcher (hold it for two seconds to quit). A GameCube controller and a USB keyboard work too.
Options go in pumpkin.cfg next to boot.dol (see README.md).
